properties.evidence: Alex asked the parent-graph question first and Anthony's framing on that node supplied the vertical/horizontal vocabulary this one is asked in. It anticipates the QUESTION and not this SHAPE: that node's parent decomposes into parts of one product, with roll-up arithmetic attached and a deferral that waits behind the decomposition coverage check. A parent over two independent products has no roll-up to perform, so neither the arithmetic nor the deferral reaches this case.
